# StoreCheck public showcase

> StoreCheck is a review-first Shopify product catalog audit tool. The canonical product site is https://getstorecheck.eu/.

## Canonical resources

- StoreCheck: https://getstorecheck.eu/
- Shopify product audit: https://getstorecheck.eu/shopify-product-audit
- Product audit checklist: https://getstorecheck.eu/shopify-product-audit-checklist
- Shopify product SEO audit: https://getstorecheck.eu/shopify-seo-audit
- Shopify catalog cleanup guide: https://getstorecheck.eu/shopify-catalog-cleanup
- Interactive demo: https://getstorecheck.eu/demo
- Canonical machine-readable guide: https://getstorecheck.eu/llms.txt

## Scope

- Connected Shopify scans are read-only.
- StoreCheck reports explainable catalog-quality findings and merchant review guidance.
- It does not claim to replace a full technical storefront crawl, backlink audit, indexation audit, or Core Web Vitals test.
- StoreCheck is independent and is not endorsed by Shopify Inc.
